tests.acceptance: Exercise invalid/missing API-key 401 in a fixture; keep last-good data and show actionable auth state, no bypass.
Redact credential header values from errors, request logs, traces and exports; disallow credential-bearing download URLs in persisted records.
Apply response rate-limit headers across concurrent jobs; retry without duplicate record insertion.
Change project slug while retaining stable source ID; preserve version/file hash and do not create duplicate project.
Support multiple files/addons per release with explicit selection; do not guess correct asset from filename alone.
Reject truncated/hash-mismatched downloads without modifying known-good installation.
Run first launch, settings, cache, logs, downloads and updates under a disposable filesystem write trace; all owned data remains under portable root unless explicitly opted out.
Move a stopped portable folder to a new path with spaces/non-ASCII characters; restart and resolve relative paths.
Deny writes to portable root and surface an actionable error rather than silently falling back to AppData.
Interrupt update before commit; retain/recover previous executable and data without overwriting unrelated files.
Attempt destination collision during import/restore; preserve both source and existing destination, require explicit safe selection.
Copy to another account/machine with dummy credentials only; require reauthentication where encryption is device-bound, never downgrade to plaintext.
